sources.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
sources.evidence: August 24, 2026 public introduction names Apodex 1.1 mini as the locally deployable 35B member. It distinguishes the live full-model workbench from Mini and says weights and documentation were still in progress.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini model card
sources.evidence: Declares Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B as base_model, Apache-2.0, exact Mini deployment commands, native function calling, dedicated think/reasoning_content parsing and 262144 context.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 40 language layers, 30 linear-attention and 10 full-attention, 256 routed experts with top-8 selection and a shared expert. Includes vision configuration and one MTP layer; tie_word_embeddings=false; max_position_embeddings=262144.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini Apache License
sources.evidence: Repository LICENSE contains Apache License Version 2.0; model-card license metadata agrees. The inherited license retains Alibaba Cloud copyright attribution.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public, ungated repository at revision 4e4f109a5e32d1306dc6c75e4995a09c8b881811 with 15 downloadable safetensors shards. Structured safetensors metadata reports 35,951,822,704 BF16 parameters; this is an element count, not repository byte size.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini weight index and all 15 safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Fetched the index and byte-range JSON headers from every referenced shard at the pinned revision. Summed shape products for all 1,811 unique BF16 learned tensors: 35,951,822,704. Names exactly match the index. No quantization scales, zero points, rotary buffers or other nonparameter tensors were present. Component counts and methodology are recorded below.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini chat template
sources.evidence: Dedicated thinking is enabled by default and enable_thinking=false emits an empty thinking block. Renders function-call schemas and responses; accepts image and video message blocks.

sources.title: Core Models (LLM API)
sources.evidence: Exact apodex-1.1-mini row lists 35B and 262144 context. Hosted core-model API explicitly accepts text-only input. No server-side tool execution is distinct from model-generated function calls.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini repository history
sources.evidence: Initial weight commit 62583b464707ad58848bc2ab066747d8d5b02533 is dated August 25, 2026; subsequent August 26 commit updates README. Repository creation August 17 and latest modification are not used as release dates. Commit history does not establish the time the repository became public.

sources.title: Apodex 1.1 technical report
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted with pdftotext. Calls Mini a 35B model and compares it to Apodex 1.0 Mini and other systems, but supplies no exact full-checkpoint or activated count. arXiv history identifies first submission August 24 and revision August 25, 2026.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini image processor configuration
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint packages Qwen3VLProcessor with Qwen2VLImageProcessorFast and image preprocessing dimensions matching its vision encoder.

sources.title: Apodex-1.1-mini video processor configuration
sources.evidence: Packages Qwen3VLVideoProcessor; treated as architecture support evidence rather than a standalone claim of documented video deployment.

sources.title: Apodex official Mini GGUF deployment instructions
sources.evidence: Developer deployment command uses llama-server with the exact Mini alias and --mmproj mmproj-apodex1.1-35b-F16.gguf, corroborating enabled vision in an official local deployment.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Explicit Language Model specifications state nominal 35B total and 3B activated, 40 layers, 8 routed plus 1 shared expert, and the hybrid Gated DeltaNet/Gated Attention layout. Used only with verified exact structural equivalence to the base explicitly named by Apodex.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B configuration
sources.evidence: Downloaded base configuration is JSON-equal to the complete Apodex Mini configuration, including language dimensions, expert routing, shared expert, embedding tying, vision and MTP.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B index and all shard headers
sources.evidence: Compared all 1,811 base tensor names and shapes to the exact Apodex checkpoint; every name and shape matches. Only 60 tensors totaling 4,800 parameters differ in dtype (base F32, Apodex BF16); these are learned A_log and linear-attention normalization weights, not architecture changes.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 MoE reference implementation
sources.evidence: Confirms A_log and dt_bias are nn.Parameter, packed gate_up_proj/down_proj are learned expert parameters, and embedding/output layers are separately instantiated. Ordinary Transformers inference ignores optional mtp.* tensors; their checkpoint storage is still included in total parameters.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 MTP implementation
sources.evidence: Identifies MTP projection, transformer/MoE layer and normalization tensors as the optional inference MTP module; its embedding and output layers reuse checkpoint language weights. No duplicate MTP embedding/output tensors exist in the counted artifact.

sources.title: Official Apodex 1.1 release post (X syndication)
sources.evidence: X-owned syndication endpoint returns official Apodex_AI post 2091916791308313018 at 2026-08-24T15:53:23Z. The post introduces Apodex 1.1 and explicitly links Open Weights to the official apodex-11 collection. Direct x.com retrieval returned 403; primary content was accessed through X syndication.

developer.note: Publisher uses Apodex and Apodex AI branding; retain catalog developer normalization.

family.note: Normalized family name for the developer-designated Apodex 1.1/Mini line.

release_date.note: Official public introduction/open-weight announcement date, confirmed by developer blog and dated official release post. The blog says weight rollout was still in progress and the retained first weight commit is August 25; exact historical download timing is not independently established. Neither repository creation nor modification dates are substituted.

open_weights.note: Public, ungated official repository provides the complete checkpoint; all shard headers were fetched without authentication.

license.note: Explicit repository license and model-card metadata.

parameters_b.note: Exact full-checkpoint count from tensor shapes, independently matching structured metadata: 34.660610688B language model plus output head, 0.446571248B vision, 0.844640768B MTP. All 1811 tensors are learned BF16 parameters, including A_log/dt_bias; no quantization buffers. Untied input/output embeddings are counted separately; shared MTP embeddings are not duplicated.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal inherited language-model figure, not an exact whole-checkpoint active total. Apodex explicitly names Qwen3.5-35B-A3B as its base; complete config and all 1811 tensor names/shapes match, so the base developer's stated 3B activated Language Model specification applies to the unchanged routing/dimensions. Requires active_parameters_scope=language_model. Excludes vision preprocessing and optional MTP; precision conversion of 4800 parameters does not alter counts.

architecture.note: Exact checkpoint is hybrid Gated DeltaNet/attention MoE: 40 language layers, 256 routed experts, 8 selected per token plus one shared expert; vision encoder and optional one-layer MTP are present.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint configuration, deployment instructions and hosted API documentation agree. No base-model extrapolated context is transferred.

modalities.note: Model/checkpoint scope: text and image input with text output, corroborated by official vision-enabled GGUF deployment and exact vision weights/processor. Apodex hosted core API is text-only. Video assets are packaged but no explicit exact-model developer video usage was verified, so video is not added.

reasoning.note: Dedicated thinking output/parser and explicit enable_thinking toggle establish reasoning mode beyond ordinary chain-of-thought prompting.

tool_call.note: Exact model card documents trained native function calling and tool_calls parsing. Tools require external execution; hosted lack of server-side tool execution does not negate this model capability.

description.value: Open-weight Qwen3.5-based MoE model with thinking, function calling and a 262,144-token context window.
description.note: Neutral description of directly documented lineage, architecture and features.

patch.name: Apodex 1.1 Mini
patch.description: Open-weight Qwen3.5-based MoE model with thinking, function calling and a 262,144-token context window.

patch.notes: Full checkpoint has 35.951822704B parameters, including vision and MTP. Active 3B is the base developer's nominal language-model count, supported by identical configuration and tensor shapes; it excludes vision and MTP. The local model accepts images, while the hosted API is text-only. August 24 is the public introduction date; weights were uploaded August 25, and exact public download timing was not independently established.

summary: All 14 fields assessed. Verifies full checkpoint total of 35.951822704B from all tensor headers, with vision/MTP components; supports the nominal 3B active language-model figure by explicit base lineage plus complete configuration and tensor-shape equivalence. Adds MoE architecture, family and local image input while distinguishing text-only hosted access. Retains August 24 public introduction and documents later weight upload.

checkpoint_audit.count_method: Sum product(shape) of each unique learned tensor in all 15 safetensors JSON headers; independently compare the index and structured metadata. No division of shard byte sizes.

backbone_comparison.active_count_basis: Developer-published nominal 3B language-model figure inherited only after direct exact-model structural equivalence; not inferred by multiplying full-checkpoint count by 8/256.

research_scope: Read the full exact-model technical report, current card/config/license/history, all original checkpoint headers, exact linked base sources and all base checkpoint headers. Targeted exact-name searches did not identify a later developer comparison paper disclosing a different active count; no third-party estimates are used.
